integrated_ownership.description: How much of the company each party holds, directly and through the companies it holds: shares are multiplied along each path and added across paths, and a company's own shares are given back to its other holders. Each source is computed on its own; figures from two sources are listed side by side, never added. Shareholdings only — voting rights, roles and control are not shares. For a person it is arithmetic on what was filed, not a determination of beneficial ownership. Context, not a finding.

institutional_shareholders.disclaimer: Form 13F lists the positions institutional investment managers have discretion over for funds and clients. It is not a record of beneficial ownership: it never enters the ownership graph and no risk signal reads it.
notes: Positions overlap — a manager's report can include another manager that also reported the same shares — so they are never added together.
Long positions only, as at the quarter end and filed up to 45 days later. A manager may be allowed to leave a position out under confidential treatment, so a manager missing here says nothing.
A manager's Form 13F figure and its Schedule 13D/13G figure can differ: they are dated differently and filed under different rules.
institutional_shareholders.attribution: Contains data from the SEC's Form 13F data sets (U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission), public domain.
institutional_shareholders.caveat: Reported by the filers and not verified by the SEC; no substitute for the filings themselves.
